d: Pakistan ke sindh prant men, sarkari skulon men hindu bachchon ko unke dharm ke bare men vishesh kitabon ke zarie parhaya ja raha hai. is nae pathyakram ko sabse pahle umarkot aur tharparkar zilon men lagu kiya gaya hai. ismen hindu manyataon, dharmik granthon, tyoharon aur paranpraon ko shamil kiya gaya hai. sarkari aankron ke anusar, sindh ke sarkari skulon men kaksha 3 se 5 tak 2,72,000 se zyada hindu bachche parh rahe hain. yah kadam aise samay men uthaya gaya hai jab pakistan ke skuli pathyakram men dharmik pratinidhitv aur dharmik alpasankhyakon ke sath hone vale bartav ko lekar…
